claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details] (second column) all rows
claims.evidence: "The first protein digestion was performed in-solution with 0.2 μg rLysC ... A second enzymatic digestion was performed overnight with 0.8 μg Trypsin".

Deposited parameters.txt (MaxQuant 2.0.1.0, the version in the PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol): "MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm"; PRIDE: "All other parameters were the same in all searches." Precursor tolerance is not in parameters.txt and is omitted.

limitations: Archaeological paint contains possible protein binders from multiple animals; organism is not applicable at source level rather than broadcasting project-level pig/sheep identifications.
PRIDE README maps Blank_930 to the earlier set and Blank_1943 to the later set by sequential run IDs; no explicit year is given for each blank.
A single cleavage-agent column represents final trypsin digest; earlier Lys-C is documented in the paper.
The yellow early aliquot was analysed in 2017 per README, despite its 2016files filename and grouping in early set.
Blank_930 is assigned to the 2016 set and Blank_1943 to the 2021 set from the run-ID sequence and the README grouping; RAW headers were not read.
